title: Pin PyYAML as a verification dependency
objective: Make PyYAML an explicit, pinned dependency of repository verification so role-pack validation stops being conditional, then remove the G-C PyYAML exemption.
acceptance: PyYAML version is pinned and documented for offline installation
Role-pack validation runs as a required check rather than a conditional skip
.agent/gate-policy.json no longer lists the toolchain.pyyaml_missing exemption and ./scripts/verify-candidate still exits 0
nonGoals: No other new dependencies (jsonschema stays out, design §11)
nextAction: run fresh specifier, coder, cleaner, and QA stages (hardener not required)
notes: scope amendment 2026-10-01 (PM): added .github/workflows/ci.yml. Once check_role_packs becomes a required check rather than a conditional skip, CI must install the pinned PyYAML or the pipeline fails; the pin is only meaningful if CI honours it.

Environment note: this machine currently has PyYAML 6.0.3 importable via the pyenv python3 (/Users/mak/.pyenv/versions/3.11.14). Earlier sandboxed runs resolved /opt/homebrew/bin/python3, where PyYAML was absent, which is what produced the observed toolchain.pyyaml_missing skip. The fix must fail closed rather than depend on which python3 is first on PATH.

scope amendment 2 2026-10-01 (PM): added .agent/README.md, which documents the verifier's toolchain behaviour and still asserts the G-C PyYAML exemption being removed here. Keeping the docs consistent in the same change.
